svg.aria-label: sesmax-core in the GeoModels layer. Planned on top of it, with no import yet: sesmax-ocean, sesmax-atmos, sesmax-land and sesmax-ice, and sesmax-couple on top of those. It builds on gridax, gaussx, spectraldiffx, geonnax, integrix, geophysix and pipekit, on filterax and vardax through its da extra and flowjax through its flows extra, each with the modules that import it, and on JAX, Equinox, diffrax, paramax, einops and jaxtyping.
